talents.e: Aspects of the Hawk and Beast add chance for attack speed boosts on auto attacks.
Raises your pets' health and armor by a percentage.
Boosts total damage from you and your pet while a pet is out.

Faster, cheaper pet revives that bring the pet back with more health.
Adds extra movement speed to the Cheetah and Pack aspects.
Your pets move faster.
Increases damage dealt by your pets and hawks.
Mend Pet can cleanse pet debuffs on heals and costs less mana.
Increases critical strike chance for your pets and hawks.
A hawk dive-bombs the target for damage, then keeps attacking for a while.
You and your pet regenerate health periodically while the pet is active.

Faster pet focus regeneration, plus some mana regen while casting.
Pet crits can grant a temporary attack speed burst.

Extends the range of your ranged weapons.
Gives Concussive Shot a chance to stun the target briefly.
Raises critical strike chance across all of your attacks.
Boosts Serpent Sting damage, cuts Viper Sting cooldown, extends Scorpid Sting.
Lowers mana costs of shots, stings, and melee abilities.
Attack power scales from a share of your Intellect.
Shortens Rapid Fire cooldown and grants a damage bonus on your next Shot.
Shortens the cooldown of Arcane Shot.
Deal bonus damage with all attacks while you have no active pet.
Party members within range gain bonus ranged attack power.
Raises critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities.
Increases the damage your Serpent Sting deals.
Serpent Sting and Rapid Killing grant mana regeneration while casting.
Boosts damage of Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley.
Short-range shot that disorients the target until damaged.
Increases damage you deal with ranged weapons.
Long-range shot with flat bonus damage and extended range for next shots.
Boosts damage against the creature types you are tracking.
Increases your parry chance.

Raises critical strike chance for all melee abilities.
Increases your total health.

Adds hit chance and shortens movement-impairing effects on you.
Briefly boosts your dodge and parry chances when activated.
Raises hit chance for traps and Feign Death.
Increases melee critical damage and off-hand weapon damage.

Cheaper traps and melee, plus mana regen chance on critical strikes.

Melee kick that also grants a short burst of movement speed.
